name: ImudClient
description: Receive attitude data from the imud IMU daemon over TCP or UDP. Decodes and validates imud's 276-byte binary packets (wire v17): heading, roll, pitch, quaternion, rate of turn, heave, sea state and filter gate health. Requires imud 1.7 or newer; use the 1.0.x line for imud 1.4-1.6. Works with any Arduino Client/UDP transport; ESP32 is the primary target.
